requested_review: Future exact scope review by @adrian.factfinder through an authorized free Market Task.
scope_inherits: Accepted A7 evidence applies only to the exact per-effect in-memory fixture. The earlier staging design applies to its offline overlay.

roles.source_dependence: One NOAA educational source family and prior reviewer exposure. The proposed validation would supply engineering evidence only.

purpose: Specify a single isolated evaluation of the actual HTTP, analysis and backend lifecycle before any C013 serving integration is considered.

source_observations.observation: The inspected request path receives public text, consent and idempotency inputs. It has no server-derived per-caller scope or private admission call wired for C013. An idempotency key is not caller identity.
The semantic matcher ranks a bounded candidate list. That list cannot by itself establish whether the original full request or an extracted fragment requires the separately reviewed literal handling.

The semantic server stores and returns grouped progress through SQLite. The existing Convex check owns legacy intake independently. An import check on a result read does not establish a shared, non-reused generation across write and disclosure.

preflight: Pin the exact staging build, reviewed policy, snapshots, model/index identity and authority generation before execution. Capture a source-to-runtime manifest for gateway, semantic server and backend.

Use isolated synthetic caller identities, inputs, data stores and an outbox sink with external publication disabled. Use only an already-authorized private service boundary. An unavailable boundary or a cross-store generation guarantee that cannot be demonstrated stops positive-consent testing and is a blocked outcome.
Record before and after export digests and all 23 established mapping results. Require unchanged active exports and C013 absent.

cases.property: Trusted identity through the normal serving path
cases.expected: The server derives scope and stable effect position. Distinct synthetic callers do not share result or job identity through public request fields. Missing authority yields no effect or payload.

cases.property: Protected literal handling independent of ranked retrieval
cases.expected: Use the exact seven reviewed literals as whole requests and selected mixed controls at known positions. Withholding and candidate exclusion hold when rank places C013 outside its window. Preserve separately eligible effects, verbatim offsets and the existing mapping results. Report the enumerated coverage only.

Exercise synchronous completion, asynchronous partial and completed reads, and one restart using the actual entry points. Retain stable order and approved unrelated effects under current authority. An invalid generation produces no prior answer, evidence, job, or partial payload for the stale response.

cases.property: Authoritative save and admission under concurrent transactions
cases.expected: In the disposable backend, capture concurrent identical admissions, changed consent or payload and same-import generation advance at admission, save and disclosure. Demonstrate one current eligible binding and job, no stale or duplicate effect, and preservation of historical state. Capture committed readback and classify unobserved conflict behavior as unverified.

required_receipt: Record reviewed build and input hashes, configuration assertions, cases with observed status and effect counts, full grouped shapes with synthetic data, positive and negative controls, and baseline comparison. Keep initial feasibility, implementation review and release conclusions separate.
release_state: C013 remains withheld. This scope has no staging execution results and confers no live intake, factual verdict, curation, routing activation, or deployment decision.

serving_source.observation_scope: Checked-out source. Deployed build was not attested.
